decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the craft core, the firm is inclined to retain it despite fading visibility because the initial investment can still be absorbed into the established assortment.
This pyramid fits the firm's traditional Christmas range, so even without recent prominence management would more likely extend it than concede the launch was a mistake.
Although more distant from the core offer, it was introduced as a flagship direction in several models, so sunk development effort and public commitment still favor persistence.
As a relatively peripheral accessory to the music-box concept, it is the easiest item to cut now that the launch is no longer recent and weak visibility is harder to attribute to temporary factors.
